- Gliscor (Ground/Flying) - poison heal, very bulky
- Dragonite (Dragon/Flying) - multiscale, dragon dance sweeper
- Primarina (Water/Fairy) - liquid voice, specs or bulky
- Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost) - same as mine
- Kingambit (Dark/Steel) - supreme overlord, bulky attacker

My team:
- Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost) - Life Orb, special attacker
- Corviknight (Flying/Steel) - defensive pivot
- Arcanine-Hisui (Fire/Rock) - physical sweeper
- Rotom-Wash (Electric/Water) - defensive pivot
- Clefable (Fairy) - Calm Mind sweeper
- Dragapult (Dragon/Ghost) - fast special attacker

Key matchups to consider:
1. Dragonite - needs something to handle it. Corviknight walls it (resists Dragon and Flying). Clefable can also handle it with Calm Mind + Moonblast.
2. Kingambit - Gholdengo can handle it (Steel typing resists Dark). Corviknight also walls it.
3. Gliscor - very bulky, hard to break. Arcanine-Hisui can break through with Head Smash. Clefable can also handle it.
4. Incineroar - Intimidate threatens physical attackers. Gholdengo (special) handles it well. Corviknight can also handle it.
5. Primarina - Water/Fairy, needs Steel or Poison. Gholdengo resists it. Arcanine-Hisui resists Water and can hit with Fire.
6. Their Gholdengo - my Gholdengo can mirror it, or Corviknight walls it.

Strategy: I want to cover Dragonite, Kingambit, Gliscor, and Incineroar.

- Corviknight: Walls Dragonite, Kingambit, Incineroar, their Gholdengo. Great defensive backbone.
- Gholdengo: Hits Kingambit super effectively (Steel vs Dark), hits Primarina (Steel vs Fairy), handles Incineroar (immune to Dark). Good special attacker.
- Arcanine-Hisui: Breaks Gliscor (Fire/Rock vs Ground/Flying), hits Kingambit (Fire vs Steel), but weak to Intimidate from Incineroar.

Alternatively:
- Clefable: Calm Mind sweeper, handles Dragonite, Kingambit (resists Dark), Incineroar (resists Dark). But weak to Gliscor (Ground).
- Dragapult: Fast, handles Dragonite (Dragon vs Dragon), but weak to Ice from Dragonite.

I think Corviknight + Gholdengo + Arcanine-Hisui is a solid core:
- Corviknight handles Dragonite, Kingambit, Incineroar, their Gholdengo
- Gholdengo handles Kingambit, Primarina, Incineroar
- Arcanine-Hisui handles Gliscor, Kingambit (Fire), and can sweep

I'll go with Corviknight, Gholdengo, Arcanine-Hisui:

- Gholdengo (special attacker, handles Kingambit/Primarina/Incineroar)
- Arcanine-Hisui (sweeper, handles Gliscor, can clean up)
